page.overview:
What is River Ankhapur?

The River Ankhapur was a small waterway found near the Lake of Steam.

The river originated near the center of the Ankhwood north of the eastern half of the Lake of Steam. It flowed southwest and west for before emptying into the sea approximately southeast of Ankhapur.
